questions: How many devices did you measure, and how many showed the multi-frequency pattern at νN = 2/3? Supplementary Note 1 refers to "The devices" (p. 13), and every figure seems to come from one device and one cooldown.
Why were the other devices set aside?
Which ranges of B, Vleft, Vright and VSi did you measure beyond the windows shown, for example around the 0.25 T by 55 mV window of Fig. 3b?
What does the second-best dataset look like? The wider Fig. 2c window (7.7 to 8.8 T) would be a natural place to repeat the Fig. 3c analysis.

The Fig. 3b window sets an FFT resolution of about 0.017 µm² in Φ0/ΔB and about 19 V⁻¹ in 1/ΔVleft, while f10 and f01 differ by 0.005 µm² and 52 V⁻¹. How stable are the assignments of f11, f02 and the higher peaks when you change the window, and does a longer field window separate f10 and f01 along B?

Does the Fig. 3c spectrum show weight at the difference frequency f10 − f01, near (−0.005 µm², 52 V⁻¹)? Single-particle paths that connect the two loops, or capacitive mixing between them, would generally add difference frequencies as well as sums, so its size helps separate those cases from your two-electron process.

How is δT obtained from the measured transmission (background subtraction, filtering), how are the visibilities in Fig. 3e extracted from the maps in Fig. 3d, and how do the decay rates B10, B01 and B11 change if the three lowest-temperature points are kept in the fits (p. 19)?

Have you measured the temperature dependence of the two (−2, 2) frequencies of Fig. 1f? There both probe spins interfere through integer channels, so the comparison would separate decay set by the copropagating probe channels from decay in the fractional channel.
